pageCache.text:
Our Vision and Staff Pledge are at the core of everything we do. They underpin our teaching and learning, and provide an environment which prepares our pupils as confident, happy citizens.
Our Jubilee Vision
We will be the very best version of ourselves!
Jubilee Staff Pledge to Pupils:
As proud members of Jubilee, our pledge is to nurture our children to flourish and become the best version of themselves
Our Behaviour Code supports our Vision:
Be the best version of ourselves
be responsible
be reflective
be respectful
British Values
At Jubilee Primary School, we develop and promote British Values throughout our school and within our curriculum.
“We want every school to promote the basic British Values of democracy, the rule of law, individual liberty, and mutual respect and tolerance for those of different faiths and beliefs.” Lord Nash
A key part of our plan for education is to ensure children become valuable and fully rounded members of society who treat others with respect and leave school fully prepared for life in modern Britain.
Our Vision and Values are at the core of everything we do. They underpin our teaching and learning, and provide an environment which prepares our pupils as confident, happy citizens.
Promoting British Values at Jubilee School
At Jubilee we embed British Values into our everyday practice so our children have the opportunity to experience British Values in many different contexts.

A message from the Principal
A huge, warm welcome to Jubilee Primary School – thank you for taking the time to visit our school website! At Jubilee, we place each child at the centre of everything we do.
My wonderful, talented and inclusive staff enthuse children to learn in a safe, happy environment. At Jubilee we celebrate the uniqueness of every Jubilee child and adult. Through our Vision ‘We will be the very best version of ourselves’ we encourage children to try their best and strive for greatness in all they do whether it is academic, sports, the arts or a specific interest or hobby.
Our equality@jubilee curriculum focus ensures that every child builds upon their understanding and appreciation of diversity. We want our children to benefit from a world without prejudice and discrimination and so develop their ability to recognise right from wrong. Our curriculum is key to inspiring children to want to learn and, as such, often reflects key events happening in the world, as well as topics the children are interested in.
Our website will provide you with a taste of life at Jubilee – but it’s even better seeing the children and our amazing space in person. So why not book a time to come and have a tour!
The site also provides up-to-date information for parents, carers, pupils and the wider community. Check out the class pages to see what your child’s class has been up to so far this year and if you are considering joining us, have a look at the types of creative learning we get up to.
I look forward to working with you and your child as they start their journey with us!

We provide opportunities for children to:

Embrace all cultures with tolerance and respect; understand, accept and celebrate diversity.
